values.note: Trailer size varies by site: some take trailers up to 35 ft, others only 25 ft. At most one RV and two tents per site; all vehicles must fit the parking spur.

sites.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/psicc/recreation/halfmoon-west-campground ('17 sites'; 'Some sites can hold trailers up to 35 feet, while others can only hold 25 feet'; 'A maximum of three tents or one recreational vehicle (RV) and two tents is allowed per site') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/10165335 ('all vehicles must fit in the parking spur'), read 2026-10-28

values.note: Generally open May through September, weather dependent (FS). recreation.gov's 2026 first-come fee season ran May 22 - Sept 6.

season.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/psicc/recreation/halfmoon-west-campground ('The facility is generally open May through September. Opening and closing dates are weather dependent') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/10165335/rates (First-come, First-served Season 2026-05-22 to 2026-09-06), read 2026-10-28

values.note: First-come only: arrive to claim and pay; sites must be occupied the first night. Pay cash, check or money order at the fee tube, or by recreation.gov Scan and Pay.

booking.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/psicc/recreation/halfmoon-west-campground ('This location is available on a first-come, first-served basis only. Visitors are required to physically arrive at the campground to purchase and claim a site'; 'A self-service fee tube is available') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/10165335 (Scan and Pay), read 2026-10-28

values.note: $26 a site (two vehicles; $11 a third vehicle). Senior/Access passes halve the site fee.

fees.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/psicc/recreation/halfmoon-west-campground ('$26 nightly fee per site for overnight camping, which includes two vehicles. A third vehicle is an additional $11 per night') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/10165335/rates (2026 First-come season: 26), read 2026-10-28

note: Leadville RD campground at ~9,900 ft beside Halfmoon Creek, off the dirt Halfmoon Rd (FSR 110; 2WD to the campground, the 4WD section is beyond; not maintained in winter) near the Mount Elbert and Mount Massive trailheads; very popular with hikers. --Claude
summary: FS page + recreation.gov Scan and Pay listing: confirmed first-come only, vault toilets, $26. Status: the FS page is labelled 'Site Temporarily Closed' with no reason given (nearby Leadville RD pages carry no label). Forest Order 02-12-01-26-39 (Willow Fire Area Closure, Oct 1 - Dec 31, 2026) closes NFS land '... to the Main Mt. Massive Trailhead, and continuing on the North side of Halfmoon Creek'; on imagery the campground and Halfmoon Rd are on the south side of the creek, at the closure's edge (Exhibit A draws the line along FR 110). The season ended in September and the order expires before the May opening, so no status was written; a human may prefer temporarily_closed until Dec 31.
Road: FS directions - 'This dirt road will lead to the Halfmoon East/West and Elbert Creek areas. (Note: This road is not maintained in the winter.)' No RV, 4WD or high-clearance wording.

Waterfront (stored riverview) stands: no per-site points; on imagery the pin is at an open grassy clearing beside FR 110 with Halfmoon Creek ~60 m away across meadow and willow - a view, not frontage.
